entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand I bought. It's a piece of junk.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller, order number 774-B-91. And I'm not 'dissatisfied', I'm telling you this thing is broken.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... Yes, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault?
The pulse tracker is complete garbage. It says my heart rate is 50 when I'm jogging! It's dangerously inaccurate. I don't want to fix it, I just want money back.

I understand your frustration with the pulse tracking. Inaccurate readings can definitely be concerning. I'd be happy to help troubleshoot that. Often, a quick software reset can resolve calibration issues.
Listen to me. I don't have time to be your IT department. I paid for a working product, not a project. Just give me my refund. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to a manager?
I hear your frustration, Sarah. I assure you, a manager isn't necessary at this point. Since you'd prefer not to troubleshoot, let me just review the return eligibility for you.
You better. I'm not paying for this defective garbage. I'll post a review on every website you can think of.

Okay, I've checked your purchase date. I see here you received the item 20 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you immediately.
Oh. Okay then. Finally. So you're sending me a return label?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating that for you now and it will be sent to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off. Once we receive the band, your refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually takes 3 to 5 business days.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
